# Synthetic tray trial B

Author: Aster Desk Lab (fictional organization).
Observation date: 2026-09-08. Publication date: unknown. Captured: 2026-09-24.
Identity: aster-tray-b-v1. Entirely invented test material.

## Measurements

For one tray cooling trial at a nominal 22 C room temperature, the open vent
reached the target in 25 minutes; the closed vent took 19 minutes.

## Recommendation

For this nominal setup, we recommend the closed vent. This is a single trial,
not evidence of a general advantage. No humidity measurement was recorded.
